shots.note: establishing: high above the doorway looking down the vault, slow crane down; Haon walks in under the camera and away down the aisle; rows of pillars, the dormant giant in the middle, the altar glowing far east
over her shoulder, long lens down the vault: the giant sits slumped in the middle, beyond it the altar glows; she stops and stares
side tracking medium: she creeps toward the giant, sword low, ember in her left hand; the giant looms ahead (right)
low angle up at the giant: its eyes light, it straightens up, taunts, and grips the two-handed axe
close on Haon: she looks up, raises the sword into a guard; ember glow on her left
low tracking at the giant's feet: heavy slow steps across the stone toward her, light handheld jolt per step
over the giant's shoulder onto Haon: it raises the axe overhead; she braces, then springs back
IMPACT: wide low side, heavy shake: the axe bites the floor where she stood, she is just clear
she sprints around the pillar and presses her back to it; light handheld follow
close: Haon pressed against the pillar, breathing hard, ember held to her chest; she glances back over her shoulder; the giant turns toward the pillar beyond it
wide, slow push: the giant stands a few meters off, facing her pillar with the axe; Haon hidden behind it on our side

markers.label: Haon enters the deepest vault through the west doorway, ember in her left hand, sword in her right
she stops: far east the altar glows; the giant warden kneels slumped in the middle
the giant warden awakens (eyes light, it straightens)
the warden taunts, then grips its two-handed axe
the warden walks at her: heavy slow steps
IMPACT: the axe bites the floor where she stood (stone chips, dust)
she sprints to the nearest pillar
she presses her back against the pillar, hidden
the warden turns toward her pillar and steps closer
the warden stops a few meters from the pillar, axe ready
